shared_elements: large quadruped animal shown in profile
incised/carved linear rendering on stone surface
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a large quadruped seen in profile, but that is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. A renders its beast as a flat outline filled with an arbitrary lattice grid and rows of short strokes, a purely schematic geometric convention, while B shows modelled relief animals with rounded bodies and a further zone of smaller creatures and serpentine/curved motifs above, with no internal geometric infill and a multi-figure composition rather than a single isolated figure.
